scenario: Resolution is a build-pipeline concern per LIMP.9.4 / LIMP.3.1 — the compiler accepts a search path / file list for library resolution. Pin: with `ha.ds` available on the loader's library map, `import ha` resolves cleanly. The library file declares one schema so the loader exercises the parse-the-library path, not just resolve-the-name.
rules_ds:
import ha

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

libraries.ha:
schema Light scope logical:
    is_on: Bool key
